question: Which three aspects of the deity are honored through these repeated salutations?
premises: Obeisance is offered to the knower of waves.
Obeisance is offered to the one associated with the thirty gods.
Obeisance is offered to the bearer of the three times.
inference: The deity is saluted as possessing knowledge of waves, connection to the thirty gods, and mastery over the three times.
uncertainties: The precise sense of 'taraṅga' (wave) in this context is not specified.
plain_english: Obeisance to the knower of waves, obeisance to the one of the thirty gods, obeisance to the bearer of the three times.
